name: hide
_deep_note: Returns deep (deep_bell) in the dragon materials: dragonhide, dragonscale and, deepest, petrified dragon. Brandon's defence-model decision 20 (2026-11-17): a Dexterity hero finds light and medium armour all the way down; it keeps the template's lower AC (the trade for the dodge and the speed).
_design_note: F1-20 medium-light. AC 2 (vs leather/padded's 1) earns its weight: the early heavy option, same AC as studded leather but available sooner. Takes a crushing blow better.
lore_template: Since armor was first thought of, folk have clothed themselves in the skins of creatures tougher than they. This wrap of thick {material_name} is lashed at the shoulders with cord, and though heavier than tanned leather it takes a crushing blow better.
forms_note: A beast's hide, hair and all, slows an edge and blunts a blow.
